notes: m21-fidelity item 4 (2026-10-29). Printed: 'You gain 4 life. If a creature died this turn, you gain 8 life instead.' The 'instead' rewrites the spell's own instruction (CR 608.2c): it gains 4 here (no creature has died yet), 20 -> 24. Then a creature dies and Radiant Fountain's 'When this land enters, you gain 2 life' gains exactly 2: 26. Before the fix the sentence was a ReplacementAbility registered for the rest of the turn, so the Fountain's 2 became 8 (32): stronger than printed.
